Mus (Jaculus jaculus) in Jahraa reserve farms
Location taken: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History. Names: Jaculus jaculus (Linnaeus, 1758), Aavikkorotta, Egyiptomi ugróegér, Gerboise des steppes, Jaculus jaculus, Jerboa, Jerbu egipci,
Jaculus jaculus can be found in central Asia, North Africa and Arabia in countries such as Sudan, Israel, and Morocco. The species is especially common in Egypt, where it gets its common name, Lesser
